dedupeText: nebulous 80s synth pop portrait 80s neon soft focus airbrush glow script typography nebula pink and blue the neon pink script acts as a vibrant header against the dark background the subject s facial features eyes and lips are the only sharp points within a diffused glowing aura the blue violet light trails create a sense of motion and cosmic depth around the central figure combine a soft focus cosmic portrait with high contrast neon script and technical corner metadata to evoke a retro futurist 1980s aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A highly stylized, soft-focus portrait of a woman emerging from a dark void, enveloped in a glowing, ethereal nebula of blue and violet light. The composition features sharp neon-pink script at the top and technical sans-serif metadata in the bottom corner, creating a contrast between organic light effects and rigid graphic elements.
coreVisualRelationships: The neon pink script acts as a vibrant header against the dark background.
The subject's facial features (eyes and lips) are the only sharp points within a diffused, glowing aura.
The blue-violet light trails create a sense of motion and cosmic depth around the central figure.
coreInvariants: Heavy airbrushed texture with visible grain.
High-contrast lighting with deep blacks and luminous highlights.
A specific palette of electric pink, cyan-blue, and deep violet.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered horizontally but positioned slightly lower, with hair/light trails expanding into the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright pink lips and the star-shaped earring serve as secondary focal points below the main eye level.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left script, follows the light trail down to the face, and settles on the technical text in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black space surrounds the central glow, emphasizing the 'emerging from darkness' theme.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the accents against a low-value, high-contrast background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid warm tones like orange or yellow.
Limit to cool blues, purples, and hot pink.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with a slight forward slant.
letterConstructionRules: Fluid, continuous strokes resembling neon tubing.
Variable line weight with thicker downstrokes.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'T' has a wide, sweeping crossbar.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, organic script paired with rigid, industrial sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the technical, futuristic look of the corner text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus portrait of a woman with 80s styling, emerging from a black background. Apply a heavy blue and violet airbrushed glow that mimics a cosmic nebula. Ensure the lips are a sharp neon pink and add a star-shaped glint to an earring. Add film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a custom neon-pink script title across the top. In the bottom right corner, add stacked, white, bold extended sans-serif text for technical metadata.

verificationChecks: Is the glow blue and violet?
Is there a grainy, airbrushed texture?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between text and image

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script is legible despite the glow.
Check that the grain doesn't obscure the facial features.
Verify the contrast between the pink lips and the blue skin tones.
Confirm the technical text is aligned to the bottom right.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a soft-focus cosmic portrait with high-contrast neon script and technical corner metadata to evoke a retro-futurist 1980s aesthetic.
